name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Radio Group. Each option is a small diamond (only speech bubbles are round): the line thickens on hover, the checked one is an ink flat that sweeps in with a paper dot. Dashed when disabled.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/radio-group". It wraps your own components/ui/radio-group, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Diamonds instead of circles; the chosen one turns to ink.
meta.usage:
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/manga/radio-group"

<RadioGroup defaultValue="ltr">
  <label><RadioGroupItem value="ltr" /> Left to right</label>
  <label><RadioGroupItem value="rtl" /> Right to left</label>
</RadioGroup>
